stem.text: A reaction involved in the Contact process is shown.

The reaction is investigated at 200 kPa and 700 K and the value of the equilibrium constant, $K_\text{p}$, is found to be Y. The reaction is then investigated at 1000 kPa and 700 K and the value of $K_\text{p}$ is found to be Z.
Which statement comparing Y and Z is correct?

A.text: Y and Z are the same.

C.text: Z is 2.2 times greater than Y.

D.text: Z is 5.0 times greater than Y.
